description: Recovered fx2-cmix GCC build with FX2_META_STREAK=1. Adds a bounded self-referential streak context to the final mixer layer, keyed by recent predictor correctness, streak bucket, bit context, line-break state, and longest match bucket.

build.packaging: cmix and english.dic are xz-packed and unpacked by program.py; both count toward the local driver program_size.

notes: Uses the recovered fx2-cmix source with the PPMD mmap remap fixed to preserve pointer stability.
Same wrapper path as fx2cmix_recovered_gcc_o3_xz_v1 so score deltas isolate the predictor experiment.
verdict: Reject. Replacing the final-layer global context with the meta-streak context regressed the archive enough to overwhelm the small program-size reduction.
